scope: 66 domain repositories created in this chat; portfolio site is validated separately

repositories.name: code-flow-studio
repositories.summary: Code Flow Studio 0.4.3 separates actual C# target exits from the Coverlet collector: approved nonzero returns have measured coverage, while three genuine collector faults remain blocked. The published source passed 419 tests and 28 subtests with 85.01% controller/training coverage, two 70-scenario twelve-language lanes and three-OS compiled native checks. Source-bound diagnostics, unused-code candidates and guarded draft navigation remain available.
repositories.rationale: Prevents valid command-line rejection paths from being mistaken for broken instrumentation while preserving failed tests, collector failures, source-hash locations and encrypted-history replay. Exact-main compiler, native and CodeQL gates bind downloadable 0.4.3 packages to the reviewed source.
limitations: Twelve bounded flat CLI adapters do not cover every framework, dependency or architecture. Measured approved C# exits do not imply 100% line/branch coverage; unused candidates are not dead-code proof.
Execution needs a separately built local Docker worker with no host fallback. Shared worker identity and containers are not a certified public hostile-code sandbox.
Hashes bind retained bytes and locations, not trusted attestation by a malicious target. UI-only report fixtures are separate from native collector evidence.

Unsigned builds; no mobile installer or notarization. Windows upgrade and disposable-profile installed-app checks passed. Populated pre-existing vault upgrades and real-credential replay were not exercised. Clean-machine installs, uninstall and non-Windows installation transactions were not tested. A five-second HTTP drain does not bound critical work or total exit.
